deadline.value: December 1 is the fall funding-priority deadline; the regular fall deadline for internationals is March 1.
deadline.quote: Fall (funding priority) December 1 December 1 | Fall May 1 March 1

also.quote: The priority deadline for funding is December 1.

supervisor.value: The BME Graduate Program Committee admits by vote; naming faculty of interest in your statement is expected.
supervisor.quote: Admission applications to a degree program are evaluated by the BME Graduate Program Committee appointed by the department head.

funding.value: Every admitted PhD student gets a 4- or 5-year funding offer (typically at least $31,500 a year plus tuition, fees and insurance).
funding.quote: The department currently offers 4 or 5-year funding packages upon admission for students pursuing the Ph.D. program. | The department sends every Ph.D. student a funding offer letter upon admission.

entry_route.value: A 96-hour PhD is for students straight from a bachelor's; a 64-hour PhD for master's holders.
entry_route.quote: The 96-hour Ph.D. is for students attaining their Ph.D. immediately following the completion of a bachelor’s degree.

app_fee.value: International applicants pay $148: the $90 Texas A&M fee plus the $58 EngineeringCAS fee.
app_fee.quote: International Applicants: $148 - Texas A&M University fee ($90) + EngineeringCAS Processing Fee ($58)

fee_waiver.value: A few fee-waiver codes are given by individual faculty to students they want to recruit; ask your intended supervisor.
fee_waiver.quote: The department provides limited fee waivers (i.e. coupon codes) to applicants. Fee waivers are provided by individual faculty to selected students whom they intend to recruit into their lab program.

gre_general.value: GRE is optional; scores are encouraged if you have them.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is optional for all applicants.

notes: Applications via EngineeringCAS. Rolling decisions; admits 10-15% of applicants.
